summary: PIM Manager no longer takes over existing groups without an administrator's approval.

fixes.title: Existing groups are never taken over silently
fixes.text: A group that matches a name defined in PIM Manager, but was not created by it, now waits until an administrator adopts it on Jobs > Engine logs and errors.

fixes.title: Copy button confirms reliably
fixes.text: On the Engine logs page, the Copy button now confirms every copy.
